title: Identified frequency set
statement: Let $n,m$ be nonnegative integers, let $\pi:\{0,\ldots,n-1\}\to\{0,\ldots,m-1\}$, and let $S\subseteq\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$. The identified frequency set consists of those $j$ for which the number of elements of $S$ mapped to $j$ by $\pi$ is odd.
